name: ui-bottom-sheet-detents
title: Bottom Sheet Drag
description: Ngón tay kéo bảng dưới từ nấc 25 % lên, thả ra bảng bám vào nấc 60 % và nền tối theo; kéo xuống một chút thì bảng về lại nấc 25 %.

credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio bottom-sheet-drag, written here): Phone 112x184 with a sheet at the 25 % detent. 0.4-1.0 s a finger drags the sheet up 44 px (power1.in); on release it snaps to the 60 % detent in 0.76 s power2.out. 2.3-2.7 s the finger drags it down 28 px; release snaps back to 25 % in 0.76 s. Backdrop opacity = 0.6 × clamp((openness − 0.25) / 0.75). Detent ticks at the side. Params: detents ([25, 60, 100] %) · snap (0.76 s, power2.out) · backdrop (0.6 tối đa) · drags [[giây, px]]. Released after the drag it snaps to the nearest detent in 0.76 s (power2.out); the backdrop is 0.6 × (openness − 0.25) / 0.75.
